publicNotes:
## Build notes

The formal information center anchors a compact garden plaza beneath the waterfalls. Dense planting, produce displays, irrigation channels, and a large waterwheel give the build a working village feel. Wooden stairs and raised paths divide the scene into small public spaces without making it feel crowded.
